data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hani' which means 'graceful' or 'pleasing'. In Islamic tradition, it represents the grace and beauty of God's creation and the inner qualities of kindness, wisdom, and trustworthiness. The name Haniyya carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haniyya usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
